# zentral_turbo_configuration (Resource)

The resource `zentral_turbo_configuration` manages Turbo configurations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "zentral_turbo_configuration" "default" {
  name = "Default"
}

resource "zentral_turbo_configuration" "tuned" {
  name                    = "Tuned"
  description             = "Faster refresh, smaller result batches"
  collect_inventory       = true
  inventory_interval      = 3600
  default_check_interval  = 7200
  config_refresh_interval = 300
  results_batch_size      = 50
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Turbo configuration.

### Optional

- `collect_inventory` (Boolean) If `true`, the agent posts a full machine inventory snapshot on the inventory interval. Defaults to `true`.
- `config_refresh_interval` (Number) How long the agent may trust a cached configuration before refreshing it, in seconds. Must be between `60` and `604800`. Defaults to `600`.
- `default_check_interval` (Number) Default run interval in seconds for recurring jobs that don't set their own. Must be between `60` and `604800`. Defaults to `86400`.
- `description` (String) Description of the Turbo configuration.
- `inventory_interval` (Number) Inventory refresh interval in seconds. Must be between `60` and `604800`. Defaults to `86400`.
- `results_batch_size` (Number) Maximum number of results the agent uploads per request. Must be between `1` and `1000`. Defaults to `100`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `ID` of the Turbo configuration.
